extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors who find that a Wikipedia article does not exist under a given title and want to create or recover that content. Covers account requirements, alternative creation paths, search and troubleshooting steps for missing or deleted pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you do not meet these account requirements, you cannot create the article directly. Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article (alternative creation paths)
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page yourself (e.g., not autoconfirmed), the article wizard helps authors prepare drafts for review; you can also request that another editor or an administrator create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or existing coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Australia comedy history' in existing articles. Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling and whether other pages link to the intended title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay / purge troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you believe the page was just created, allow time for updates or use the purge function to refresh the page cache.

rubrics_metrics.name: Case sensitivity and redirect suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify alternative capitalizations and, if appropriate, create a redirect from the missing title to the correct article to help readers find the content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted page — check the deletion log and reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a page was removed, consult the deletion log to understand why and to determine whether recreating the article is appropriate (e.g., address notability or sources issues first).
